Edit details

Tracklist (optional)

Add a YouTube and/or Spotify link per track to play it accurately. Editing rows here (or using "Load current tracklist" to start from what's already showing) switches this album to a manually-maintained tracklist — it stops picking up future automatic tracklist lookups.

Import from Last.fm

Reads your public scrobble history and logs listens against albums already in your crate. Needs a free Last.fm API key (from last.fm/api/account/create — you only need the "API key" value, not the secret). After this first import, CRATE will quietly check for new scrobbles each time you open it \u2014 no need to come back to this screen.

Matched — will be logged (0)
Not in your crate — skipped, review separately (0)

Spotify API

Connect a free Spotify app so Spotify links go straight to the matched album instead of a search page. Create one at developer.spotify.com/dashboard (Web API, no redirect URI needed) and paste the Client ID and Client Secret below. Stored only in this browser.

In-app playback (Premium)

To play music inside CRATE — with real transport controls, volume, and queue — connect your Premium account. In your app's dashboard, add this exact Redirect URI first, then hit Connect:

Discogs API

Used for the "⤓ Discogs" genre lookup in Edit details. Discogs requires a personal access token for search — generate a free one at discogs.com/settings/developers (Generate new token; no OAuth app registration needed). Stored only in this browser.

YouTube API

Used for the "Match" button on the tracklist builder and "Edit track properties…" to search YouTube for real candidate videos instead of opening a search tab. Get a free API key: Google Cloud Console → create/select a project → enable "YouTube Data API v3" → Credentials → Create API key. The free tier is limited (100 searches/day), so matching only runs when you click it, never automatically. Stored only in this browser.

New Releases

Checks Spotify for recent releases by artists already in your crate, and skips anything that looks like you already have it. Needs a Spotify Client ID/Secret saved (⚙ → Spotify API…) — the same one that powers tracklist lookups elsewhere, no extra setup. A full check can take a little while for a big crate, since it's one request per artist.

Genre Taxonomy

Set which broader genre each one falls under \u2014 e.g. Shoegaze under Alternative Rock, itself under Rock. A genre can have more than one parent too (Glam Punk under both Punk Rock and Glam Rock \u2014 separate multiple with commas, same as the Genre/Secondary Genre fields elsewhere). Filtering by a parent genre then also surfaces everything beneath it in the hierarchy, and the left panel's Genres list shows the tree with counts that include the whole branch. Leave a genre's field blank for top-level (no parent). Stored only in this browser.
